artisan.readlog:ask: Ask a reader's library a question through Ollama, or warm the models up
artisan.readlog:docs-check: Verify that the documentation still matches the repository, and regenerate docs/machine/
artisan.readlog:embed: Compute embeddings for reading entries that lack a current one (needs Ollama)
artisan.readlog:smoke: Verify a running ReadLog instance: health route, home page, database, migrations, demo data, providers
artisan.readlog:snapshot: Write a static, browsable snapshot of the seeded app to a directory
